question: Should the named LiteLLM onboarding choice grow its own interactive base-URL prompt and discovery step, or should users be routed to the existing Custom Provider path for non-local LiteLLM proxies?
rationale: Both paths are technically plausible, but the choice changes provider-owned onboarding UX, credentialed endpoint probing, and the boundary between bundled provider setup and generic custom endpoints.

options.title: Add LiteLLM URL Prompt
options.body: Have `litellm-api-key` ask for or confirm the proxy base URL before model selection while keeping non-interactive `--custom-base-url` compatible.

options.title: Route To Custom Provider
options.body: Keep LiteLLM as localhost/default-model setup and update docs/prompts to make Custom Provider the supported remote-proxy path.

options.title: Defer To Dynamic Catalog Work
options.body: Leave this blocked until the broader dynamic catalog and credentialed discovery contract is settled in related provider-discovery issues.

recommendation.title: Add LiteLLM URL Prompt
recommendation.body: Have `litellm-api-key` ask for or confirm the proxy base URL before model selection while keeping non-interactive `--custom-base-url` compatible.

likelyOwner.reason: This person owns the recent pluginized LiteLLM onboarding shape and non-interactive custom-base-url behavior in current history.
